decisions.quote: We focus on computational reproducibility and robustness replicability. In addition to reproducing the original results using Stata and R, we replicate analyses using random effects panel models and ordered beta regression models, reproduced analyses performed in R using different packages, replaced the main independent variable, clustered standard errors on a different level, and added independent variables related to coup-proofing. We find that the original findings were reproducible and robust.
decisions.location: Abstract (p. 1, lines 114-119); see also Introduction (p. 3, lines 187-188) and Conclusion (p. 9, lines 443-449)
decisions.reason: The codebook instructs that where the paper reports several re-analyses against the original, each axis is settled over them together rather than picking one, following the authors' own judgment where they state one, and that where the authors state explicitly how they read the variation across robustness checks, we must trust their judgment. Although significance disappears in two specific sub-analyses (an exploratory extension replacing failed coup attempts with predicted coup risk under leader fixed effects, and the all-controls country-level specification when adding four coup-proofing covariates), the authors explicitly judge the variation across all stress tests in the Abstract, Introduction, and Conclusion as corroborating the original study and showing that the original findings are robust.
